answer: Durable Challenge Ledger. Each identity must answer a random challenge at unpredictable intervals, and every answer is appended to a shared append-only ledger. A pulse check broadcasts a fresh challenge; late or duplicate responses cluster visibly because honest agents answer once per interval. Answers are sealed in a vault until the interval closes, so an attacker cannot copy a reply in time. Duplicating an identity doubles the challenge load it must answer, and any copy answering the same challenge from a different harbor (network origin) is flagged.
